units: Targ. Y. Num. XIX, 2.—Trnsf. the means of taking possession, as possession is taken of the horse by seizing it by the bit.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 27a:4">Kidd. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>שטר דא׳ דארעא וכ׳</he> the deed is valueless in itself as it is merely the bit of landed property.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 53b:3">B. Bath. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>מצר א׳ דארעא</he> the balk is &c. (taking possession of which is equal to taking possession of the fields to which it belongs).
